name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
summary: Provides collateral-free credit guarantee cover to Member Institutions lending to DPIIT-recognised startups, routed through the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC).
administering_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
implementing_agency: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC)
benefit_description: Credit guarantee cover up to Rs. 10 crore per borrowing startup, extended to Member Institutions (banks, NBFCs, AIFs) against loans given to eligible startups.

criteria.description: The applicant must be recognised as a startup by DPIIT.
criteria.source_quote: Startup whose eligibility is certified by the Member Institution for the purpose of guarantee cover.

criteria.description: CGSS does not lend or guarantee to the startup directly; the startup must first secure a loan sanction from an empanelled Member Institution, which then applies for the guarantee cover.
criteria.source_quote: CGSS does not provide guarantee cover to DPIIT recognised startups directly, but through a Trustee (NCGTC), which in turn provides guarantee cover to MIs who provide loans to startups.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register on the Startup India portal.

document_requirements.document_name: Loan sanction letter from a Member Institution
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Apply for a business loan with a Member Institution empanelled under CGSS; the MI certifies eligibility and requests guarantee cover.

windows.notes: Applications processed on a rolling basis through empanelled Member Institutions.

benefits.description: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover on loans extended by Member Institutions to eligible startups.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Guarantee is invoked by the Member Institution in case of default, not disbursed to the startup directly.
benefits.source_quote: CGSS is aimed at providing credit guarantees up to a particular limit to finance eligible borrowers, i.e., eligible startups, against loans extended by Member Institutions (MI).
